emoji.picker.search.description: Label of the search field of the custom emoji picker; it finds emoji by shortcode or other name.

emoji.picker.grid.description: Accessible name of the grid of emoji in the custom emoji picker.

emoji.picker.recent.description: Heading of the emoji picked recently on this device, first in the picker.

emoji.picker.uncategorized.description: Heading of the emoji without a category in the picker.

emoji.picker.empty.defaultMessage: 絵文字が見つかりません
emoji.picker.empty.description: What the custom emoji picker shows when nothing matches the search.

settings.profile.display_name.emoji.defaultMessage: 表示名に絵文字を入れる
settings.profile.display_name.emoji.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that opens the custom emoji picker for the display name.

settings.profile.note.emoji.defaultMessage: 自己紹介に絵文字を入れる
settings.profile.note.emoji.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that opens the custom emoji picker for the bio.

reaction.picker.button.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the icon button in a post's action bar that opens the picker of emoji to react to the post with.

reaction.picker.title.defaultMessage: リアクションの絵文字
reaction.picker.title.description: Accessible name of the popover that holds the picker of emoji to react to a post with.

reaction.picker.grid.defaultMessage: リアクションの絵文字
reaction.picker.grid.description: Accessible name of the grid of emoji in the picker of reactions.

reaction.picker.unicode.description: Heading of the group of common Unicode emoji in the picker of reactions, before the custom emoji of the server.

reaction.toggle.description: Accessible name of a toggle under a post that reacts to it with an emoji that others reacted with, or takes the reaction back when pressed again. {emoji} is the emoji itself or its :shortcode:. The number of reactions is read as its description.

reaction.list.label.description: Accessible name of the group of emoji reactions under a post.

reaction.list.open.description: Button after the emoji reactions under a post that opens the list of the accounts that reacted.

reaction.list.title.description: Title of the dialog that lists the accounts that reacted to a post, each with its emoji.

reaction.list.loading.defaultMessage: リアクションを読み込んでいます
reaction.list.loading.description: Shown in the dialog of the accounts that reacted to a post while the first page loads.

reaction.list.failed.defaultMessage: リアクションを読み込めませんでした：{reason}
reaction.list.failed.description: Shown in the dialog of the accounts that reacted to a post when the first page failed to load. {reason} is the error message.

reaction.list.retry.description: Button that loads the list of the accounts that reacted to a post again after it failed.

reaction.list.empty.defaultMessage: まだだれもリアクションしていません。
reaction.list.empty.description: Shown in the dialog of the accounts that reacted to a post when there are none (the reactions were taken back meanwhile).

reaction.list.load_more.description: Button at the end of the list of the accounts that reacted to a post that loads the next ones.

reaction.list.load_more_failed.defaultMessage: 続きのリアクションを読み込めませんでした：{reason}
reaction.list.load_more_failed.description: Shown and announced when the next page of the accounts that reacted to a post failed to load. {reason} is the error message.

status.reaction.on.defaultMessage: {emoji} でリアクションしました
status.reaction.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user reacted to a post with an emoji. {emoji} is the emoji itself or its :shortcode:.

status.reaction.off.defaultMessage: リアクションを取り消しました
status.reaction.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user took back their emoji reaction to a post.
